label: Sunny Unplugged Alert
info: Every 5 minutes: Pushbullet alert when solar > 700 W, the Victron EV charger says Disconnected, it is 9 AM-4 PM Central, and the car is within radius_m of /data/tesla/home-location.json (car location from the driver's /tmp/<VehicleId>.json cache). At most one alert per 30 minutes. No Tesla API calls.
